messages:
ana: Heads-up: planning a controlled cutover to the hardened base image this Thu 09:00 PDT. Key blockers: RBAC for the build/signing service, KMS key rotation approach, audit log sink, and vuln triage. Who can own coordination?
kevin: I can own RBAC changes. Quick Q: do we need new service account scopes for the image signer or just granting a signer role on the KMS key?
sophia: For cosign-backed signing we should avoid broad scopes. Grant a KMS signer role to the service account; no project owner. Lia can confirm exact role.
lia-security: Grant `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` to `svc-image-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Deny broad perms. Also plan: export admin activity & data access audit logs to secure-bucket with 365d retention.
ben: On the build side we'll run the builder in an ephemeral pool and produce SBOM + signature. I'll add an RBAC PR and attach CI link: <https://go/repo/pull/1234>
deploy-bot: Note: scheduled canary push configured: 3 nodes us-west1, canary window 10m, auto-rollback threshold 5% 5xx.
kevin: Rollout plan proposal: 1) add signer role to svc-image-signer 2) create new KMS key version in staging (no primary rotation yet) 3) sign & push canary 4) smoke tests & attestation 5) promote key alias and full rollout. Rollback: revoke binding and revert to previous signed image tag. Lia, thoughts?
lia-security: Don't rotate primary key during cutover. Create a new key version and validate signatures first. Only flip alias after successful canary & audit verification. Also require `cosign verify` to pass and SBOM checksum match.
sophia: Runtime hardening items: ensure images run with `--no-new-privs`, user namespace mapping, drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN/CAP_NET_ADMIN. Ben, can the builder inject seccomp and a minimal filesystem?
ben: Yes. Builder will apply seccomp + remove setcap bits. Example Dockerfile snippet:
```
FROM redwood/base:hardened-202603
COPY seccomp.json /etc/seccomp/profile.json
RUN find /usr/bin -type f -exec setcap -r {} + || true
```
kevin: Audit logging action: create sink from cloud audit -> `gs://secure-logs-redwood/images/`. Add pubsub alert for missing exports. Lia will create sink and grant write.
lia-security: I'll create the sink and pre-authorize the IAM binding. Also adding an offline gate: verify SBOM + `cosign verify` output before promoting the image.
sophia: Vulnerability policy: block promotion on any critical/high CVE that lacks a fixed patch or mitigated flag. I'll create Jira epic and quick triage template.
nana: (typo) Sorry — ana: Thanks all. Ben, post PR + confirm CI green by Thu 02:00 PDT. Kevin open the RBAC PR. If anything goes wrong follow IR checklist: revert promoted tag, revoke signer binding, restore previous key version and notify #incidents.
kevin: Ack. I'll ping #eng-oncall 30m before start and add runbook link in the PR.
ben: PR posted: <https://go/repo/pull/1234> CI green ✅
sophia: I'll own vuln triage during the rollout window. Lia, can you confirm sink created by EOD?
lia-security: Sink + IAM grant queued, will update when done.
deploy-bot: Canary promoted -> full rollout started (09:12Z). Auto-rollback disabled by manual override.
nana: Final update: full rollout complete 09:40Z, no incidents, audit export verified, SBOMs recorded. Great work :tada: 
kevin: Filing short notes under /docs/cutovers/ with links to PR + logs.
file_notes: cutover coordination thread for hardened base image, RBAC, KMS signing, audit sink, vuln triage, and rollout checks
